domain-information: A Food Truck Owner plans the daily route to reach popular customer locations.
A Food Truck Owner updates the truck menu to edit items for the day.
A Food Truck Owner assigns chefs to a food truck.
A Chef prepares ingredients early to ensure timely service during operating hours.
A Chef cooks menu items as orders arrive to serve customers quickly.
A Chef registers a payment by a customer.
A Customer places an order for food to enjoy a meal from the food truck.
A Customer pays for the meal using a card or cash to complete the transaction.
A Supply Vendor receives a report by a chef that is running low on ingredients.
A Supply Vendor delivers fresh ingredients to the truck to maintain its stock levels.
A Supply Vendor confirms the delivery with the chef to ensure accuracy.
A Food Truck Owner reviews sales at the end of the day to track performance.
A Food Truck Owner adjusts future routes and menu items based on customer feedback.
